Business: Klodijan Plumbing and Heating GAS SAFETY

headline: Day or night,
Klodijan answers.
copy.sub: Boilers, leaks, radiators and bathrooms across Reading and nearby. Gas Safe registered, open 24/7, free estimates and all work guaranteed.
copy.about_alt: A new boiler Klodijan fitted in a cupboard, with fresh copper pipework
copy.lede: Klodijan Shalli is a Gas Safe registered plumbing and heating engineer based in Reading. He answers his own phone, explains what's wrong in plain English and fixes it properly. Customers have had him out on a Saturday afternoon, a Sunday and at half seven on a weeknight.
copy.services_intro: Plumbing and heating, big jobs and small.

services.title: Boiler repairs
services.blurb: Breakdowns, leaks, pressure loss, no heating or hot water. Found fast and explained.
services.intro: Most breakdowns are fixed on the first visit, and you get told what went wrong and why.

services.title: New boilers
services.blurb: Gas, electric and oil-fired boilers fitted, including awkward swaps that need the old pipework rerun.
services.intro: Sized for your home, fitted neatly and left with everything working and explained.

services.title: Leaks and pipework
services.blurb: Dripping taps, burst pipes, wastes and gas pipes capped or moved.
services.intro: Leaks fixed before they cause damage, and new pipework run neatly.

services.title: Radiators and power flushing
services.blurb: New radiators, valves, cold spots and sludge cleared out of the system.
services.intro: Cold radiators are usually sludge or air. Both get sorted.

services.title: Bathrooms, toilets and taps
services.blurb: Full bathroom plumbing, toilets, basins, showers, sinks and taps.
services.intro: From one dripping tap to a whole new bathroom, plumbed properly.

services.title: Hot water and underfloor heating
services.blurb: Cylinders, immersion heaters, tanks and wet underfloor heating.
services.intro: Hot water that lasts and floors that heat evenly.
